name: aulora
description: Aulora: self-hosted team chat with browser, desktop, and mobile clients.

scripts.lint: turbo run lint && biome check scripts package.json
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build && bun run test:infra && bun run test:release && bun run docs:check && bun run release:check
scripts.test:infra: node --test infra/push-relay/test/*.test.mjs infra/docker/backup/test/*.test.mjs infra/docker/install/test/*.test.mjs && bun test infra/docker/update/*.test.mjs
